scope: Bounded IDs/titles/short hypotheses only, not full history evidence or authorization

items.hypothesis: The native minimum-scene-length clamp changes M95 fine hierarchy resolution with the batch peer on actual unchanged TRAIN supports, not merely a constructed short scene.

Native multiscale partitioning should preserve physical point-group membership under lossless superpoint row relabeling after undoing the permutation. Recompute FPS/partitions rather than merely permuting fixed maps; distinguish changed cluster labels from changed physical co-membership.

Fine FPS leaves exclude physical contact donors belonging to other leaves. A sparse physical-contact feature exchange across leaves can create a distinct point-feature information path absent from same-leaf FLE, without query/language routing.

M95 coarse context is shared by target and non-target supports inside mixed coarse clusters. Its existing broadcast may specifically degrade target discrimination at contaminated foreground supports, independently of cross-leaf physical contact exchange.

The observed foreground/non-target tradeoff from existing M95 scale interventions can be fully explained by a spatially constant selected-query logit shift, rather than a change in spatial discrimination.

Existing fine readback contains each leaf value and shared pooled ancestor values, but no direct content-dependent value exchange between fine sibling leaves. A fixed reversible transport may add discriminating sibling detail without changing the point-mass-weighted fine pre-fusion mean. Whether this is a useful deficit is UNKNOWN and must be tested, not inferred from conservation.

Replacing only the middle-scale independent token FFN with fixed geometric directional convolution can exchange spatial context among 64 middle tokens before original HCG readback, improving referential localization. Efficacy unknown until native training.

Coarse scene tokens can define context-dependent channel relationships while each fine token retains its own spatially local values. A coarse-derived grouped channel operator may improve fine semantic interpretation before original HCG readback; efficacy unknown until native training.

A coarse-to-fine affine prolongation may transmit coarse semantic intercepts while keeping child variation related to actual geometry. It replaces fine/middle independent semantic constants and non-affine variation with parent intercept plus geometric-subspace projection; task efficacy unknown.

Passing refined fine tokens through the original fixed-child mean before the original middle FFN, and refined middle tokens before the original coarse FFN, may compose nonlinear local evidence across hierarchy levels before the unchanged single HCG/inst_feats readback. This changes information dependence, not pooling weights or hyperparameters; task efficacy is unknown.

Within one existing coarse parent, a middle token may benefit from nonlinear accumulated sibling evidence rather than an independent FFN or one-hop directional spatial stencil. A bidirectional recurrent state makes every occupied sibling in its deterministic geometry chain reachable before original HCG readback. Efficacy and task deficit remain unmeasured.

Fixed signed orthogonal analysis within original coarse-parent middle-token groups, followed by the original pointwise nonlinear FFN and inverse synthesis, may create useful sibling evidence dependence before unchanged HCG/inst_feats readback. Preserve zero response with b=f(0); efficacy, population bottleneck and novelty are unknown.

Original middle tokens within each unchanged coarse parent need nonlinear complement composition: a geometry-balanced binary tree summarizes proper subtrees bottom-up and combines ancestor-outside with sibling-inside top-down; each leaf receives exactly its same-parent other supported tokens. Replace only middle FFN operator while retaining original cf skip, fine/coarse/raw banks/CSORT/HCG and single inst_feats delivery.

Replace only the original middle FFN with strict-exclusive sibling-prefix/suffix recurrent factorization: each normalized token enters its own linear readout block, while the shared forward/reverse scan states exclude that token and cover its original true-supported same-parent siblings. This removes the own-to-context mixing edge present in inclusive PSBR. Preserve original LN/raw-cf skip/fine-coarse/raw-CSORT/HCG/single inst_feats delivery.

Retain n independent C feature-state slots within each original true-supported middle parent. Shared nonlinear two-output2C-to2C mixing on simultaneous disjoint bit-up/bit-down matchings permits multi-stage sibling interaction and restores original IDs. This differs from compressed tree/complement summaries or single accumulated chains; efficacy is untested.

Within each original true-supported geometric middle-parent cycle, synchronous overlapping receiver neighborhoods repeatedly mix old own/+3^r/-3^r C states using shared dense3C-toC and original GELU. Minimal3^k>=n rounds permit full-parent potential dependencies with n C state slots; duplicate-minus donor is a privatezero. This is a different whole-graph factorization, not an efficacy or newly discovered coverage claim.

Original fine/middle membership edges jointly transform child and parent before private true-child equal means. Split upward evidence and retained branches; original coarse FFN composes upward messages, then middle/fine nonlinear synthesis carries context downward before original HCG and the single inst_feats writeback. Whole-graph role separation may improve native mask features; efficacy unknown.

Original M95 middle FFN processes each middle token independently. A fixed same-original-parent geometric MST can instead generate a signed nonlinear contrast at each real edge and deliver equal/opposite updates to its endpoints before original HCG. This may alter local boundary/detail evidence in the actual inst_feats mask path; whether such a deficit or gain exists is UNKNOWN.

Receiver-conditioned signed coarse-root vector messages between true supported original coarse roots, then fixed equal means and original-ancestor fine/middle synthesis, may improve final hierarchy features. This replaces independent three-scale FFNs with explicit cross-root hierarchy information flow while preserving raw membership/readback; efficacy unknown.

Compose the original fine/middle/coarse support forest through fixed (I+L)^-1 analysis, original scale-specific nonlinear FFNs once, and (I+L)^-1 synthesis before original raw skips/HCG. Whole-graph alternative; efficacy unknown.

One shared original-ancestry triplet factor jointly transforms fine/middle/coarse inputs and returns direct fine plus fixed-mean upper messages before unchanged raw skips/HCG; whole-graph alternative, efficacy unknown.

Recipient-specific directed cavity messages on the original true-supported three-level forest may provide a useful alternative hierarchy factorization before original HCG/singleinst. Each down edge excludes its reverse up branch before nonlinear processing; original ancestor raw banks still contain descendant-point information, so this is not physical self-information removal or a repaired contamination claim. Efficacy/novelty are UNKNOWN.

Persistent original-node recurrent composition through a deterministic Euler closed walk and its reverse may be a useful alternative hierarchy factorization before original HCG/singleinst. Each directed event updates only its receiver from the current receiver/sender states; reverse traversal continues the first traversal states. Whole-graph efficacy and novelty are UNKNOWN.

A shared binary nonlinear operator composed along fine-middle-coarse and fine-coarse-middle private paths, then contrasted before direct fine-path means, may provide a useful ancestor-order-sensitive alternative to independent per-scale FFNs. This is an ancestry-path whole-graph fork, not new information, diagnosed bottleneck, APF repair or proven novelty/efficacy.

Scene-local complete true-fine x true-coarse nonlinear vector messages produce both endpoint marginals, then original fine-parent composition conditions middle deltas before unchanged raw skips/HCG/singleinst. This whole-DAG alternative is not a proof of new information, novelty, task deficit or efficacy.

Synchronous full-neighbor nonlinear node-state composition over the original true-supported three-level forest for each component exact tree diameter may provide a useful whole-DAG alternative before unchanged raw skips/HCG/singleinst. Ordinary GNN-family efficacy/novelty/task deficit remain UNKNOWN; this does not repair PES or prove new information.
